items.publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine — MedlinePlus
items.title: Evaluating Health Information
items.sourceSection: Summary > How can I evaluate health information on the Internet?
items.paraphrase: Before relying on a health website, assess who runs it, funding, editorial review, cited sources, update dates, and the limits of applying information to an individual.
items.application: Use as a source-quality checklist when BONES prepares non-diagnostic educational materials.
items.criticalLimit: Not medical advice or proof that any personal treatment is safe; providers must assess personal applicability.

items.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
items.paraphrase: WCAG 2.2 defines testable web accessibility success criteria, but following them does not address every accessibility need.
items.application: Use as a candidate standard for reviewing web interface accessibility, subject to specific criteria tests.
items.criticalLimit: A reference to WCAG alone does not establish that SCOTTY or any interface conforms to it.

items.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
items.title: NIST Special Publication 800-207: Zero Trust Architecture
items.paraphrase: Zero trust avoids granting access simply because of a network location or asset ownership; resources require explicit authentication and authorization decisions.
items.application: Use as architectural context when drafting agent identity and resource-boundary test questions.
items.criticalLimit: The guidance does not prove that SCOTTY's actual deployed services enforce any particular access rule.

items.title: PostgreSQL 18 Documentation — Row Security Policies
items.paraphrase: With PostgreSQL row security enabled, missing applicable policies default to denying ordinary row access; table owners and bypass roles require special attention.
items.application: Use as candidate background for designing server-side database authorization tests.
items.criticalLimit: This does not install, enable or verify actual row-level security on a SCOTTY database.
